network_units: decimal bytes summed by sampled guest interface RX/TX counters, not billed Internet egress
basis: Proposed twenty-dollar reservation for one disposable 30-minute host, 8-GiB root and at most 100 decimal GB sampled guest traffic. The former ten-dollar policy and its approval remain unchanged. The larger reservation is provisional pending a fresh retained pricing review and operational qualification; it is not an invoice cap.
enforcement: Independent deadline reaper and host watchdog; 50-ms sampled guest output/traffic guard can overshoot. Generated code runs on a credential-free disposable lab VM. This is not adversarial metering or a guaranteed AWS bill ceiling.
limitation: Not production-qualified. Retain fresh pricing evidence, validate the expanded sampled-counter envelope and deadline cleanup, and bind exact executor, wrapper and policy hashes before activation. Physical equipment and arbitrary paid services are not covered.
approval_scope: User-requested 100-GB allowance; production activation requires a separate explicit release request and passing operational checks.
